content_blocks.title: Work through the example
content_blocks.text: Read the small example, predict every output line, then run it locally with a compatible runtime. Uses a temporary file, not a project path; close resources even after failures. The host may restrict I/O libraries. Keep the smallest reproducible case if the observed behavior differs.

content_blocks.code:
local file = io.tmpfile()
assert(file, "could not create temporary file")
file:write("Lua data\n")
file:seek("set")
print(file:read("*l"))
file:close()
